posts.text: Date night in Cleveland. Let’s go Cavs…all the way back!

Today I’m thinking of Gold Star families like Gary and Karla Ward, whose son Christian served as an Army Specialist when he was killed. I’ve met families like them across Ohio, and their sacrifice is something that most of us can’t imagine. We owe them gratitude for the freedoms we enjoy and which we should never take for granted.

Video

This Memorial Day, we remember the fallen men & women who made the ultimate sacrifice, and we honor them by supporting those they left behind. The Gold Star families who bear unimaginable burdens deserve our enduring support. The veterans who served alongside the fallen deserve our care and the opportunities they earned. Happy Memorial Day, across Ohio & our country.

Medicaid fraud isn’t a victimless crime. Everyone pays higher healthcare costs as a result - because the fraud artificially increases demand for healthcare services & diverts taxpayer $$ away from its intended recipients.

Video

Simple formula: prosecute Medicaid fraud, recover billions, strike a deal with the feds that allows Ohio to keep a majority of the savings. I’ll get it done.

Video

Faith, family, patriotism, & hard work beats victimhood, identity politics, grievance, & envy. Incredible energy at Liberty Valley Church today. True patriots who love our state & country, we won’t let you down. 🇺🇸 🇺🇸

Thoughtful conversation this afternoon with @SobolJordan & the leadership of the United Way of Greater Cleveland. We share a vision of delivering upward economic mobility to all Ohioans. Great discussion about the role of family & well-paying jobs in our state.

Build, build, build. Great visit to the DiGeronimo Companies in Brecksville today. Started in 1956 with a backhoe, bulldozer, a truck, and a few guys. Now a bigtime developer in northeast Ohio. That American Dream is real & we’re going to revive it.

We want the best 4-year universities in the country, and we also want more schools to train students in the skilled trades - to be electricians, welders, plumbers, & carpenters. Those goals aren’t in tension, they actually go together.

Video

The problem with many liberal arts universities over the last decade isn’t merely that they were “too liberal,” but that they actually *abandoned* the values of classical liberalism they once proclaimed: individualism, free speech, and open debate.

Video

We’ll prosecute Medicaid fraud, recover billions, and strike a deal with the feds that allows Ohio to keep most of the savings. That’s the first step to make healthcare more affordable after I’m elected. Details are in my WSJ piece today:
wsj.com/opinion/an-easy-way-…
We’re going to bring high-paying jobs back to Ohio in droves. Great time meeting the workers at Uline in Etna, Ohio today. Lower costs, bigger paychecks, coming soon.

My message to doctors, nurses, and other healthcare providers: I’ll create a state where you can spend more time caring for patients instead of filling out mountains of paperwork. That actually goes hand-in-hand with combating Medicaid fraud.

Video

It’s time for a fresh approach in Ohio.

Video

An uncomfortable truth: over the last decade, Ohio Medicaid enrollees have increased from 2.9 million to 3 million, while Ohio’s Medicaid expenses have risen from $27 billion to $47 billion. This is insanity.

Video

It’s the truth.


Daily Wire (@realDailyWire)

.@VivekGRamaswamy thanks @lukerosiak for his investigation into Ohio Medicaid fraud:

"I think it's fair to say that if you had not just reported the facts the people in this room who are working hard to solve these problems wouldn't have the platform...to make this a priority."

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/realDailyWire/status/2056758189324898805#m

I’ll strike a sensible win-win deal with the federal government in January to allow Ohioans to keep more of the savings from crushing Medicaid fraud & then make that a top priority for the first 6 months of my administration.

Video

Simple formula: crush Medicaid fraud & put that $$ back in the pockets of Ohioans. Shouldn’t be controversial.

Video

Ending the epidemic of Medicaid fraud requires a leader at the top who’s willing to shake up the bureaucracy. That’s exactly what I’ll do & bring some real government efficiency to Ohio.
